title: The E-measure
summary: We introduce the E-measure: a measure-like generalization of the E-value to a class of hypotheses. Unlike classical measures, E-measures are closed under infimums instead of addition. They arise from a compatibility axiom with logical implications, that there should be at least as much evidence against more specific hypotheses. We show that E-measures are the only non-dominated such objects, if the hypothesis class is closed under intersections.
